SELECT 
    ts."School Name",
    CASE WHEN ts."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS charter_school,
    ts."Low Grade" AS grade_low,
    ts."High Grade" AS grade_high,
    CASE 
        WHEN (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) BETWEEN 1200 AND 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance,
    ts.free_meal_rate - ca.avg_free_meal_rate AS deviation
FROM (
    SELECT 
        *,
        "Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / NULLIF("Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda'
      AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
    ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC
    LIMIT 1
) ts
LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON ts.CDSCode = ss.cds
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") * 1.0 / SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") AS avg_free_meal_rate
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda'
      AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
) ca

SELECT "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
AND "School Type" = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State,
    s.Latitude,
    s.Longitude,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS Enrollment_K12,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS FRPM_Percent_K12,
    CASE
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 75 THEN 'High FRPM'
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 50 THEN 'Medium FRPM'
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 50 THEN 'Low FRPM'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS FRPM_Category,
    sat.AvgScrRead,
    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite,
    sat.NumTstTakr,
    sat.enroll12 AS SAT_Enroll12,
    strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) AS OpenYear,
    s.StatusType,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS SAT_Rank
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
  AND f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" DESC;

SELECT
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    s.Street AS LocationStreet,
    s.City AS LocationCity,
    s.State AS LocationState,
    s.Zip AS LocationZip,
    s.MailStreet,
    s.MailCity,
    s.MailState,
    s.MailZip,
    s.Website,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS EnrollmentK12,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS FRPMCountK12,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPMPct,
    sa.enroll12 AS Enrollment12,
    sa.NumTstTakr,
    sa.AvgScrRead,
    sa.AvgScrMath,
    sa.AvgScrWrite,
    sa.NumGE1500,
    CASE
        WHEN sa.NumTstTakr > 0 THEN (sa.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / sa.NumTstTakr)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS PctGE1500,
    CASE
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 70
             AND sa.NumTstTakr > 0
             AND (sa.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / sa.NumTstTakr) > 20
        THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` < 30
             AND sa.NumTstTakr > 0
             AND (sa.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / sa.NumTstTakr) < 10
        THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
        ELSE 'No unexpected performance'
    END AS PerformanceCategory
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 100
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT s.Phone
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Direct'
  AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'

SELECT
    sat.sname AS school_name,
    sat.dname AS district_name,
    sat.cname AS county_name,
    sat.AvgScrRead,
    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite,
    (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS sat_performance_rank,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS poverty_level_frpm_percent
FROM schools sch
JOIN satscores sat ON sch.CDSCode = sat.cds
LEFT JOIN frpm ON sch.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE sch.Virtual = 'F'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400
ORDER BY total_sat DESC

SELECT 
    s.sname AS school_name,
    sat.AvgScrRead,
    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite,
    (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) AS total_avg_sat,
    sat.NumTstTakr,
    frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS frpm_percent,
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` < 25 THEN 'Low Poverty'
        WHEN frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 25 AND frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` < 50 THEN 'Moderate Poverty'
        WHEN frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 50 AND frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` < 75 THEN 'High Poverty'
        ELSE 'Very High Poverty'
    END AS poverty_level,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS ranking,
    CASE NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) DESC)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Top Quartile'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Upper Middle Quartile'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Lower Middle Quartile'
        ELSE 'Bottom Quartile'
    END AS performance_category
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND sat.NumTstTakr > 500
ORDER BY total_avg_sat DESC;
SELECT s.Phone FROM satscores AS t INNER JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
    s.School AS School_Name,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.County,
    f.`School Type`,
    f.`District Type`,
    f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS Charter,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment_K12,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS Free_Meal_Count,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS Free_Pct,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS FRPM_Count,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPM_Pct,
    ss.NumTstTakr,
    ss.AvgScrRead,
    ss.AvgScrMath,
    ss.AvgScrWrite,
    ss.NumGE1500
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON f.CDSCode = ss.cds
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores
INNER JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 560
AND schools.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT s.sname AS school_name, s.dname AS district_name, s.cname AS county_name,
       sch.City, sch.State, sch.County, sch.Street, sch.Zip,
       s.NumTstTakr, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, s.AvgScrWrite,
       f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
       f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal_count_k12,
       f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS pct_free_eligible_k12,
       f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count_k12,
       f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct_frpm_eligible_k12,
       sch.Charter AS charter_indicator
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 10
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH school_data AS (
    SELECT
        frpm."School Name" AS school_name,
        frpm."County Name" AS county,
        frpm."District Name" AS district,
        frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" + frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS total_enrollment,
        frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_percent,
        frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter_status,
        satscores.AvgScrRead,
        satscores.AvgScrMath,
        satscores.AvgScrWrite,
        satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite AS total_sat,
        satscores.NumTstTakr,
        satscores.NumGE1500,
        CASE WHEN satscores.NumTstTakr > 0 THEN CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / satscores.NumTstTakr ELSE 0 END AS sat_percent_ge1500,
        CASE
            WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 75 THEN 'High'
            WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS frpm_category
    FROM frpm
    INNER JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
    WHERE (frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" + frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 500
      AND (frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 60
           OR (CASE WHEN satscores.NumTstTakr > 0 THEN CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / satscores.NumTstTakr ELSE 0 END) > 0.30)
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    county,
    district,
    total_enrollment,
    frpm_percent,
    charter_status,
    AvgScrRead,
    AvgScrMath,
    AvgScrWrite,
    total_sat,
    NumTstTakr,
    NumGE1500,
    sat_percent_ge1500,
    frpm_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC) AS enrollment_rank_in_county,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY frpm_category ORDER BY total_sat DESC) AS sat_rank_in_category
FROM school_data
ORDER BY county, frpm_category, enrollment_rank_in_county

SELECT s.*, (frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS free_meal_rate, (sat.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sat.NumTstTakr) AS sat_excellence_rate
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
INNER JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
  AND (sat.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sat.NumTstTakr) > 0.3
ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT sc.School, sc.Phone, sc.City,
       CASE WHEN sc.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS CharterStatus,
       CASE
           WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High Poverty'
           WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty'
           WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 25 THEN 'Low Poverty'
           ELSE 'Very Low Poverty'
       END AS PovertyClassification,
       CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr AS ExcellenceRate
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
JOIN frpm f ON sc.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY ExcellenceRate DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT dname FROM satscores INNER JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY dname ORDER BY AVG(AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
INNER JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND schools.County = 'Alameda'
  AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT s.sname, sc.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores AS s
INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rank;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr < 50 THEN 'under 50 testers'
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr <= 100 THEN '50-100 testers'
        ELSE '100-250 testers'
    END AS testing_volume_category,
    AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS avg_read_score,
    AVG(s.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score,
    AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_write_score,
    AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_num_test_takers,
    AVG(s.enroll12) AS avg_enrollment_12,
    COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.County = 'Fresno'
  AND sch.Charter = 1
  AND sch.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250
GROUP BY testing_volume_category
ORDER BY
    CASE testing_volume_category
        WHEN 'under 50 testers' THEN 1
        WHEN '50-100 testers' THEN 2
        WHEN '100-250 testers' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip, s.Phone, s.Website,
       sat.sname, sat.dname, sat.cname, sat.enroll12, sat.NumTstTakr,
       sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite, sat.NumGE1500,
       frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter_status,
       frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment,
       frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS frpm_percent
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
JOIN frpm ON sat.cds = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active' AND sat.NumTstTakr >= 10
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH HighSchools AS (
  SELECT f.*
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.County = 'Amador'
    AND f.`Low Grade` = '9'
    AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_schools,
  AVG(HighSchools.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS avg_enrollment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN HighSchools.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_schools,
  COUNT(*) - SUM(CASE WHEN HighSchools.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_schools,
  AVG(HighSchools.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) AS avg_poverty_rate,
  COUNT(DISTINCT HighSchools.`District Code`) AS num_districts,
  AVG(sat.AvgScrRead) AS avg_sat_read,
  AVG(sat.AvgScrMath) AS avg_sat_math,
  AVG(sat.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_write,
  (SELECT `School Name`
   FROM HighSchools
   ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
   LIMIT 1) AS largest_school_name,
  MAX(HighSchools.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS largest_enrollment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN HighSchools.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_poverty_schools
FROM HighSchools
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON HighSchools.CDSCode = sat.cds

SELECT
  AVG(CAST("Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / NULLIF("Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 1 END) AS charter_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN (s.Charter = 0 OR s.Charter IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS non_charter_count,
  AVG(t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_total,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 600 THEN 1 END) AS very_high_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" <= 600 THEN 1 END) AS high_count
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
INNER JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
  AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700;

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY s.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT frpm.`School Name`, schools.Street, schools.City, schools.State, schools.Zip
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE (frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30

SELECT DISTINCT s.sname
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)") > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0;

SELECT s.School, f."Educational Option Type"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
AND (SELECT AVG(sat2.AvgScrMath) FROM schools s2 JOIN satscores sat2 ON s2.CDSCode = sat2.cds WHERE s2.City = 'Riverside') > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND s.City = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High School';

SELECT T1.sname, T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE (T2.OpenDate > '1991-12-31') OR (T2.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL AND T2.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01')

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Local'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM schools s2
    INNER JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Local'
  )

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT f.`School Name`, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`, f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, s.City, s.State, s.Zip, s.County, s.District, f.`School Type`, f.`Charter School (Y/N)`, f.`Low Grade`, f.`High Grade`, sat.AvgScrRead, sat.AvgScrMath, sat.AvgScrWrite, sat.NumTstTakr, sat.enroll12, sat.NumGE1500
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT s.School AS SchoolName,
       frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS FRPM_Count,
       CAST(frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / NULLIF(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) AS Eligibility_Rate,
       sat.AvgScrRead,
       sat.AvgScrMath,
       sat.AvgScrWrite,
       CAST(sat.NumTstTakr AS REAL) / NULLIF(sat.enroll12, 0) AS Participation_Rate,
       CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) AS HighScorer_Rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.Website, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT schools.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.Charter = 1
ORDER BY frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS full_name FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = (SELECT cds FROM satscores ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1) AND AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = (SELECT cds FROM satscores ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1) AND AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = (SELECT cds FROM satscores ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1) AND AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL

SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / T1.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Website
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
AND t.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.County = 'Fresno'
  AND sch.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31';

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN satscores AS sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno Unified' AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT sc.sname AS name, s.Virtual,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
    WHERE sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT name
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5 AND Virtual = 'F';
SELECT schools.EdOpsName FROM schools INNER JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.AvgScrMath, sch.County
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
  AND s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    sc.sname AS School,
    sc.AvgScrRead AS Reading,
    sc.AvgScrMath AS Math,
    sc.AvgScrWrite AS Writing,
    (sc.AvgScrRead + sc.AvgScrMath + sc.AvgScrWrite) AS Total_SAT,

    fr."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS FRPM_Eligibility_Rate,
    (sc.NumTstTakr * 100.0 / sc.enroll12) AS Test_Participation_Rate,
    AVG(sc.AvgScrWrite) OVER (PARTITION BY sc.dname) AS District_Avg_Writing,

INNER JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds

SELECT

    (c.high_frpm_schools * 1.0 / h.high_frpm_schools) AS high_frpm_schools_ratio,
    (c.total_frpm_students * 1.0 / h.total_frpm_students) AS total_frpm_students_ratio,
    (c.total_enrollment * 1.0 / h.total_enrollment) AS total_enrollment_ratio,
    (cs.avg_total_sat / hs.avg_total_sat) AS avg_sat_score_ratio
FROM (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS total_schools,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN CDSCode END) AS charter_schools,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5 THEN CDSCode END) AS high_frpm_schools,
        SUM("FRPM Count (K-12)") AS total_frpm_students,
        SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "County Name" = 'Colusa'
) c,
(
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS total_schools,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN CDSCode END) AS charter_schools,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5 THEN CDSCode END) AS high_frpm_schools,
        SUM("FRPM Count (K-12)") AS total_frpm_students,
        SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "County Name" = 'Humboldt'
) h,
(
    SELECT AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_total_sat
    FROM satscores
    JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE schools.County = 'Colusa'
      AND AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
) cs,
(
    SELECT AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_total_sat
    FROM satscores
    JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE schools.County = 'Humboldt'
      AND AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
) hs

    WHERE s2.County = 'Stanislaus'
) cea
CROSS JOIN (

           AVG(sat2.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math,
           AVG(sat2.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_write

) csa
ORDER BY rank_frpm, rank_sat

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_clients,
       COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_active_loans,
       SUM(l.amount) AS total_active_loan_amount,
       AVG(l.amount) AS avg_active_loan_amount
FROM client c
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT r.district_id
    FROM (
        SELECT d.district_id, d.A3, d.A11,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY d.A11 DESC) AS rnk
        FROM district d
        WHERE d.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000
    ) r
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS female_cnt
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
        GROUP BY district_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
    ) f ON r.district_id = f.district_id
    WHERE r.rnk <= 3
) q ON c.district_id = q.district_id
INNER JOIN disp dsp ON c.client_id = dsp.client_id
INNER JOIN account a ON dsp.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND l.status = 'A'
WHERE c.gender = 'F';
