FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11) FROM client c2 JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id WHERE c2.gender = 'F' AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'))

SELECT d.account_id
FROM client AS c
INNER JOIN district AS dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND dis.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)

SELECT
    c.gender,
    CASE
        WHEN CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) < 30 THEN 'Young'
        WHEN CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) <= 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END AS age_group,
    d.A3 AS region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts,
    COALESCE(SUM(inc.total_income), 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(SUM(exp.total_expenses), 0) AS total_expenses,
    COALESCE(SUM(inc.total_income), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(exp.total_expenses), 0) AS net_income
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_income
    FROM trans
    WHERE type = 'PRIJEM'
    GROUP BY account_id
) inc ON a.account_id = inc.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_expenses
    FROM trans
    WHERE type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY account_id
) exp ON a.account_id = exp.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
GROUP BY c.gender, age_group, d.A3
ORDER BY c.gender, age_group, d.A3;

WITH
qualified_disp AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id, d.disp_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
),
client_loans AS (
    SELECT qd.client_id,
           COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_loans_total,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_active_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_completed_loans,
           COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
           COALESCE(AVG(l.amount), 0) AS avg_loan_amount
    FROM qualified_disp qd
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON qd.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY qd.client_id
),
client_trans AS (
    SELECT qd.client_id,
           COUNT(t.trans_id) AS num_transactions,
           COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_transaction_volume,
           COALESCE(AVG(t.amount), 0) AS avg_transaction_amount
    FROM qualified_disp qd
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON qd.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY qd.client_id
),
client_cards AS (
    SELECT qd.client_id,
           COUNT(c.card_id) AS card_count,
           GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.type) AS card_types
    FROM qualified_disp qd
    LEFT JOIN card c ON qd.disp_id = c.disp_id
    GROUP BY qd.client_id
)
SELECT c.client_id,
       c.gender,
       c.birth_date,
       c.district_id,
       COALESCE(cl.num_loans_total, 0) AS num_loans_total,
       COALESCE(cl.num_active_loans, 0) AS num_active_loans,
       COALESCE(cl.num_completed_loans, 0) AS num_completed_loans,
       cl.total_loan_amount,
       cl.avg_loan_amount,
       ct.num_transactions,
       ct.total_transaction_volume,
       ct.avg_transaction_amount,
       COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
       cc.card_types,
       CASE NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY ct.total_transaction_volume DESC)
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'High'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
       END AS service_usage_category
FROM client c
JOIN client_trans ct ON c.client_id = ct.client_id
LEFT JOIN client_loans cl ON c.client_id = cl.client_id
LEFT JOIN client_cards cc ON c.client_id = cc.client_id
ORDER BY ct.total_transaction_volume DESC;

SELECT a.*
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(amount)
      FROM loan
      WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1997'
  );

SELECT a.account_id FROM account a INNER JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.duration > 12 AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993' AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(l2.amount) FROM account a2 INNER JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id WHERE l2.duration > 12 AND STRFTIME('%Y', a2.date) = '1993');

SELECT
    AVG((julianday(b.date) - julianday(b.birth_date)) / 365.25) AS avg_age_opening,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.total_loans > 0 THEN b.client_id END) AS total_with_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.has_completed = 1 THEN b.client_id END) AS completed_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.has_debt = 1 THEN b.client_id END) AS debt_loans,
    MIN(strftime('%Y', b.date)) AS earliest_year,
    MAX(strftime('%Y', b.date)) AS latest_year
FROM (
    SELECT c.client_id, a.account_id, a.date, c.birth_date
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
      AND dist.A2 = 'Sokolov'
      AND d.type = 'OWNER'
) b
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_completed,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_debt
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
) l ON b.account_id = l.account_id

SELECT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE date = (
    SELECT MIN(date)
    FROM trans
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1995'
)

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
AND t.balance > 3000;

WITH target_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id
    FROM card ca
    JOIN disp d ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE ca.issued = '1994-03-03'
),
client_age AS (
    SELECT 
        client_id, gender, birth_date, district_id,
        (strftime('%Y', '1994-03-03') - strftime('%Y', birth_date)) 
        - (strftime('%m-%d', '1994-03-03') < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date)) AS age_at_issue
    FROM target_clients
),
accounts_of_client AS (
    SELECT client_id, account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM client_age)
),
trans_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        a.client_id,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS num_transactions,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_trans_amount,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM accounts_of_client a
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY a.client_id
),
order_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        a.client_id,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders,
        COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total_order_amount
    FROM accounts_of_client a
    LEFT JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    GROUP BY a.client_id
),
loan_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        a.client_id,
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_loans,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans
    FROM accounts_of_client a
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY a.client_id
),
account_count AS (
    SELECT client_id, COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
    FROM accounts_of_client
    GROUP BY client_id
),
comprehensive AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.client_id,
        ca.gender,
        ca.birth_date,
        ca.age_at_issue,
        ca.district_id,
        d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7,
        d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16,
        COALESCE(ac.num_accounts, 0) AS num_accounts,
        COALESCE(t.num_transactions, 0) AS num_transactions,
        COALESCE(t.total_trans_amount, 0) AS total_trans_amount,
        t.avg_balance,
        COALESCE(o.num_orders, 0) AS num_orders,
        COALESCE(o.total_order_amount, 0) AS total_order_amount,
        COALESCE(l.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
        COALESCE(l.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
        COALESCE(l.active_loans, 0) AS active_loans,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(l.num_loans, 0) > 0 AND ca.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
            WHEN COALESCE(l.num_loans, 0) > 0 AND ca.age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
            ELSE 'Non-borrower'
        END AS borrower_category
    FROM client_age ca
    JOIN district d ON ca.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN account_count ac ON ca.client_id = ac.client_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_agg t ON ca.client_id = t.client_id
    LEFT JOIN order_agg o ON ca.client_id = o.client_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_agg l ON ca.client_id = l.client_id
)
SELECT 
    *,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue DESC) AS age_rank
FROM comprehensive
ORDER BY gender, age_rank;

SELECT
    a.date AS account_opened_date,
    JULIANDAY('1998-10-14') - JULIANDAY(a.date) AS days_open,
    c.gender AS owner_gender,
    CAST((JULIANDAY('1998-10-14') - JULIANDAY(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS owner_age,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = t.account_id AND t2.date <= '1998-10-14') AS total_transactions,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card cd JOIN disp d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE d.account_id = t.account_id AND cd.issued <= '1998-10-14') AS cards_issued,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = t.account_id AND l.date <= '1998-10-14') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS had_loan_before
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE t.date = '1998-10-14' AND t.amount = 840;

SELECT
    dp.district_name,
    dp.region,
    dp.avg_salary_rank,
    dp.unemployment_rank,
    (julianday('1994-08-25') - julianday(li.account_date)) AS days_open_before_loan,
    cd.total_clients,
    cd.male_clients,
    cd.female_clients,
    cd.avg_age,
    COALESCE(tb.num_transactions, 0) AS num_transactions_before,
    COALESCE(tb.total_income, 0) AS total_income_before
FROM (
    SELECT
        loan.loan_id,
        loan.account_id,
        account.district_id,
        account.date AS account_date
    FROM loan
    JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25'
) li
JOIN (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        A2 AS district_name,
        A3 AS region,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A11 DESC) AS avg_salary_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A12 ASC) AS unemployment_rank
    FROM district
) dp ON li.district_id = dp.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_clients,
        SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_clients,
        SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_clients,
        AVG((julianday('1994-08-25') - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25) AS avg_age
    FROM client
    GROUP BY district_id
) cd ON li.district_id = cd.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
        SUM(amount) AS total_income
    FROM trans
    WHERE type = 'PRIJEM' AND date < '1994-08-25'
    GROUP BY account_id
) tb ON li.account_id = tb.account_id

SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.date AS trans_date, t.type, t.operation, t.amount, t.balance, t.k_symbol, t.bank, t.account,
       c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id AS client_district_id,
       d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, d.A5, d.A6, d.A7, d.A8, d.A9, d.A10, d.A11, d.A12, d.A13, d.A14, d.A15, d.A16,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(loan_id || ' : ' || amount || ' ' || date) FROM loan WHERE account_id = t.account_id) AS associated_loans,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(order_id || ' : ' || amount || ' to ' || account_to) FROM "order" WHERE account_id = t.account_id) AS associated_orders
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS dp ON t.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE dp.client_id IN (
    SELECT disp.client_id
    FROM card
    JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
    WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21'
)
ORDER BY t.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.gender FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY A11 DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC LIMIT 1

WITH max_loan_account AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC, loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM max_loan_account)
  AND t.date > a.date
ORDER BY t.date ASC, t.trans_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND dist.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT disp.disp_id
FROM trans
INNER JOIN disp ON trans.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 5100
  AND trans.date = '1998-09-02'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

WITH base_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS open_date, a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
client_demo AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_owners,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_owners,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_owners,
        AVG(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', ba.open_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) AS avg_age_at_open
    FROM base_accounts ba
    JOIN disp di ON ba.account_id = di.account_id AND di.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id
),
trans_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawal_amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM base_accounts)
),
loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM base_accounts)
),
quarterly AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', ba.open_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1 END) AS q1_accounts,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', ba.open_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 1 END) AS q2_accounts,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', ba.open_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 1 END) AS q3_accounts,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', ba.open_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 1 END) AS q4_accounts
    FROM base_accounts ba
),
total_accounts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_opened_accounts FROM base_accounts
)
SELECT
    ta.total_opened_accounts,
    cd.total_owners,
    cd.male_owners,
    cd.female_owners,
    cd.avg_age_at_open,
    COALESCE(ts.total_transactions, 0) AS total_transactions,
    COALESCE(ts.total_deposit_amount, 0) AS total_deposit_amount,
    COALESCE(ts.total_withdrawal_amount, 0) AS total_withdrawal_amount,
    COALESCE(ls.total_loans, 0) AS total_loans,
    COALESCE(ls.good_loans, 0) AS good_loans,
    COALESCE(ls.bad_loans, 0) AS bad_loans,
    q.q1_accounts,
    q.q2_accounts,
    q.q3_accounts,
    q.q4_accounts
FROM total_accounts ta
LEFT JOIN client_demo cd ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN trans_stats ts ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN loan_stats ls ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN quarterly q ON 1=1

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    c.district_id AS client_residence_district_id,
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    a.date AS account_opened_date,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    d.A4 AS inhabitants,
    d.A5 AS municip_lt_499,
    d.A6 AS municip_500_1999,
    d.A7 AS municip_2000_9999,
    d.A8 AS municip_gt_10000,
    d.A9 AS number_of_cities,
    d.A10 AS ratio_urban,
    d.A11 AS average_salary,
    d.A12 AS unemployment_rate_95,
    d.A13 AS unemployment_rate_96,
    d.A14 AS entrepreneurs_per_1000,
    d.A15 AS crimes_95,
    d.A16 AS crimes_96,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id) AS total_transactions,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS prijem_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'PRIJEM') AS total_prijem_amount,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS vydaj_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ') AS total_vydaj_amount,
    (SELECT AVG(t.balance) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id) AS avg_balance,
    (SELECT MIN(t.balance) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id) AS min_balance,
    (SELECT MAX(t.balance) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id) AS max_balance,
    (SELECT t.balance FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id ORDER BY t.date DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_balance,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id) AS loan_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id) AS total_loan_amount,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.payments), 0) FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id) AS total_loan_payments,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) FROM disp di2 JOIN card ca ON di2.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE di2.client_id = c.client_id AND di2.account_id = a.account_id AND di2.type = 'OWNER') AS card_count,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ca.type) FROM disp di2 JOIN card ca ON di2.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE di2.client_id = c.client_id AND di2.account_id = a.account_id AND di2.type = 'OWNER') AS card_types,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id) AS order_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM "order" o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id) AS total_order_amount
FROM client c
JOIN disp dsp ON c.client_id = dsp.client_id AND dsp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN account a ON dsp.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT 
    c.birth_date AS birthday,
    CAST((julianday(l.date) - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age_at_loan,
    d2.A2 || ', ' || d2.A3 || ', ' || d2.A4 || ', ' || d2.A5 AS location,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
     FROM trans t
     WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date < l.date) AS total_income,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
     FROM trans t
     WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date < l.date) AS total_expenses,
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
              FROM trans t
              WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date < l.date) = 0 
        THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
                   FROM trans t
                   WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date < l.date) AS REAL) * 100.0 /
             (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
              FROM trans t
              WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date < l.date)
    END AS expense_to_income_ratio_percent,
    (SELECT MIN(t.balance) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date < l.date) AS balance_min,
    (SELECT MAX(t.balance) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date < l.date) AS balance_max,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ca.type || ' (' || ca.issued || ')', ', ')
     FROM card ca
     JOIN disp dp ON ca.disp_id = dp.disp_id
     WHERE dp.account_id = l.account_id
       AND dp.client_id = c.client_id
       AND dp.type = 'OWNER') AS credit_card_info,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM loan l2
     JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
     JOIN disp dp2 ON a2.account_id = dp2.account_id AND dp2.type = 'OWNER'
     WHERE dp2.client_id = c.client_id
       AND l2.date < l.date) AS previous_loans_count
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id
WHERE l.date = '1996-01-03' AND l.amount = 98832;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
INNER JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS num_inhabitants, COUNT(c.client_id) AS total_clients, SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_clients, CASE WHEN COUNT(c.client_id) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.client_id) ELSE 0 END AS percentage_male FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A4 ORDER BY CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH loan_account AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
client_account AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, la.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN loan_account la ON d.account_id = la.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT t.balance AS bal_19930322
    FROM trans t
    JOIN client_account ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT t.balance AS bal_19981227
    FROM trans t
    JOIN client_account ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (bal_19981227 - bal_19930322) * 100.0 / bal_19930322 AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end

SELECT d.A3 AS region, (SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(l.amount)) AS pct_amount_fully_paid, (COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS pct_loans_completed, AVG(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN (l.payments * l.duration - l.amount) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_interest_successful, AVG(l.payments * l.duration - l.amount) AS avg_interest_all FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3;

WITH regional AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region,
           CASE WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' ELSE 'Medium' END AS loan_size,
           COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 END) AS no_issue_loans
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY d.A3, loan_size
),
overall AS (
    SELECT loan_size,
           SUM(total_loans) AS overall_total,
           SUM(no_issue_loans) AS overall_no_issue
    FROM regional
    GROUP BY loan_size
)
SELECT r.region,
       r.loan_size,
       ROUND(100.0 * r.no_issue_loans / r.total_loans, 2) AS region_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * o.overall_no_issue / o.overall_total, 2) AS overall_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * r.no_issue_loans / r.total_loans - 100.0 * o.overall_no_issue / o.overall_total, 2) AS difference
FROM regional r
JOIN overall o ON r.loan_size = o.loan_size
ORDER BY r.loan_size, r.region;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    d.A10 AS urban_ratio,
    COALESCE(client_info.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
    ROUND(client_info.avg_age, 2) AS avg_age,
    client_info.genders,
    COALESCE(trans_agg.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(trans_agg.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(trans_agg.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    (SELECT tr.balance FROM trans tr WHERE tr.account_id = a.account_id ORDER BY tr.date DESC, tr.trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_balance,
    COALESCE(loan_agg.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(loan_agg.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
    COALESCE(loan_agg.defaulted_loans, 0) AS defaulted_loans,
    COALESCE(loan_agg.running_loans, 0) AS running_loans,
    COALESCE(loan_agg.finished_loans, 0) AS finished_loans,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(loan_agg.defaulted_loans, 0) > 0 THEN 'High'
        WHEN COALESCE(loan_agg.running_loans, 0) > 0 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS risk_assessment
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        disp.account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) AS client_count,
        AVG(1993 - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) AS avg_age,
        GROUP_CONCAT(c.gender) AS genders
    FROM disp
    JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
    GROUP BY disp.account_id
) client_info ON a.account_id = client_info.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
) trans_agg ON a.account_id = trans_agg.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
        SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defaulted_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
) loan_agg ON a.account_id = loan_agg.account_id
WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND a.date <= '1993-12-31'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
ORDER BY a.account_id;

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
INNER JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
INNER JOIN district AS dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND dist.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND a.date <= '2000-12-31';

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    a.opened_date,
    od.gender AS owner_gender,
    od.birth_date AS owner_birth_date,
    COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
    COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(ls.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) > 10 THEN 'High Activity'
        WHEN COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'Loan Customer'
        WHEN COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) > 10 THEN 'Active Customer'
        ELSE 'Regular Customer'
    END AS customer_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) DESC) AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, a.date AS opened_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
) a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT dsp.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM disp dsp
    JOIN client c ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE dsp.type = 'OWNER'
) od ON a.account_id = od.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
) ts ON a.account_id = ts.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
) ls ON a.account_id = ls.account_id
ORDER BY net_balance DESC

SELECT t.loan_id, t.client_id AS borrower_id, t.gender, t.birth_date, t.district_name, t.region, t.average_salary, t.unemployment_rate_1995, t.loan_date, t.amount, t.duration, t.payments, t.status, CASE t.status WHEN 'A' THEN 'Running - OK' WHEN 'B' THEN 'Running - Issues' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Finished - No Issues' WHEN 'D' THEN 'Finished - Issues' ELSE t.status END AS status_description, t.amount_rank_in_district
FROM (
    SELECT loan.loan_id, client.client_id, client.gender, client.birth_date, district.A2 AS district_name, district.A3 AS region, district.A11 AS average_salary, district.A12 AS unemployment_rate_1995, loan.date AS loan_date, loan.amount, loan.duration, loan.payments, loan.status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY district.district_id ORDER BY loan.amount DESC) AS amount_rank_in_district
    FROM loan
    JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
    JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
) t
WHERE t.loan_id = 4990

WITH national_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(A11) AS avg_salary
    FROM district
),
qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, a.date AS account_date,
           d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.amount > 300000
      AND d.A11 > (SELECT avg_salary FROM national_avg)
),
account_loans_agg AS (
    SELECT qa.account_id, qa.district_id, qa.district_name, qa.region, qa.account_date, qa.frequency,
           MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount,
           COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_loans,
           SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM qualifying_accounts qa
    JOIN loan l ON qa.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY qa.account_id, qa.district_id, qa.district_name, qa.region, qa.account_date, qa.frequency
),
owner_info AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
trans_agg AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
           COUNT(*) AS num_transactions
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT ala.account_id, ala.district_name, ala.region,
           ala.max_loan_amount, ala.num_loans, ala.total_loan_amount,
           oi.gender, oi.birth_date,
           COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
           COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
           ta.total_income - COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) AS net_income,
           COALESCE(ta.num_transactions, 0) AS num_transactions,
           CASE
               WHEN COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) > 1000000 THEN 'High Income'
               WHEN COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) > 500000 THEN 'Medium Income'
               ELSE 'Low Income'
           END AS income_classification,
           CASE
               WHEN ta.total_income IS NULL OR ta.total_income = 0 THEN NULL
               ELSE (ta.total_income - COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0)) * 1.0 / ta.total_income
           END AS savings_ratio
    FROM account_loans_agg ala
    LEFT JOIN owner_info oi ON ala.account_id = oi.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_agg ta ON ala.account_id = ta.account_id
    WHERE (ta.total_income - COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) > 0)
       OR (ta.num_transactions IS NULL)
    ORDER BY ala.max_loan_amount DESC
    LIMIT 100
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY max_loan_amount DESC) AS region_rank
    FROM combined
)
SELECT account_id,
       district_name AS district,
       region,
       max_loan_amount,
       num_loans,
       total_loan_amount,
       gender,
       birth_date,
       income_classification,
       total_income,
       total_expense,
       net_income,
       num_transactions,
       savings_ratio,
       region_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY max_loan_amount DESC;

SELECT
    r.district_name,
    r.average_salary,
    r.loan_id,
    r.amount AS loan_amount,
    r.date AS loan_date,
    r.duration,
    r.payments AS monthly_payment,
    r.status AS loan_status,
    CASE r.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Finished - OK'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Finished - Default'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running - OK'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running - Default'
        ELSE r.status
    END AS status_description,
    ROUND(r.interest_rate, 2) AS interest_rate,
    r.gender,
    r.birth_date,
    IFNULL(t.num_transactions, 0) AS num_transactions,
    IFNULL(t.total_trans_amount, 0) AS total_trans_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        ld.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ld.district_id ORDER BY ld.amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT
            l.loan_id,
            l.account_id,
            l.amount,
            l.date,
            l.duration,
            l.payments,
            l.status,
            ((l.payments * l.duration - l.amount) / l.amount * 100.0) AS interest_rate,
            a.district_id,
            d.A2 AS district_name,
            d.A11 AS average_salary,
            c.gender,
            c.birth_date
        FROM loan l
        JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
        JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
        WHERE l.duration = 60
    ) ld
) r
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(trans_id) AS num_transactions,
        COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_trans_amount
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
) t ON r.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY r.average_salary DESC, r.amount DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district, ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_rate_pct
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district d ON account.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE loan.status = 'D';

WITH year_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date, d.A2 AS district_name, STRFTIME('%m', a.date) AS month
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND a.date < '1994-01-01'
),
monthly_stats AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_accounts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN district_name = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decin_accounts,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN district_name = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS decin_pct,
    AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount END) AS avg_prijem_amt,
    AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount END) AS avg_vydaj_amt
  FROM year_accounts ya
  LEFT JOIN trans t ON ya.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY month
),
yearly_avg AS (
  SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS overall_pct
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE a.date >= '1993-01-01' AND a.date < '1994-01-01'
)
SELECT
  ms.month,
  ms.decin_pct,
  ms.avg_prijem_amt,
  ms.avg_vydaj_amt,
  CASE
    WHEN ms.decin_pct > ya.overall_pct THEN 'above'
    WHEN ms.decin_pct = ya.overall_pct THEN 'equal'
    ELSE 'below'
  END AS comparison
FROM monthly_stats ms
CROSS JOIN yearly_avg ya
ORDER BY CAST(ms.month AS INTEGER);

SELECT a.account_id,
       c.client_id,
       c.gender,
       c.birth_date,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       d.A3 AS region,
       d.A11 AS avg_salary,
       COALESCE(t.txn_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) AS net_cash_flow,
       COALESCE(l.active_loan_count, 0) AS active_loan_count,
       COALESCE(l.active_loan_amount, 0) AS active_loan_amount,
       COALESCE(l.completed_loan_count, 0) AS completed_loan_count,
       COALESCE(l.completed_loan_amount, 0) AS completed_loan_amount,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.txn_count, 0) DESC) AS rank_by_transaction_volume,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(t.total_expense, 0) DESC) AS rank_by_net_cash_flow
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
) t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 END) AS active_loan_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS active_loan_amount,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 END) AS completed_loan_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS completed_loan_amount
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
) l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
ORDER BY a.account_id;

SELECT d.A2
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal
FROM trans t
INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
AND c.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM disp WHERE type = 'OWNER')
AND c.client_id NOT IN (
    SELECT disp.client_id
    FROM disp
    INNER JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    WHERE card.type = 'credit'
);

SELECT d.A3
FROM loan l
INNER JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(amount) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id WHERE client.gender = 'M')

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       d.A3 AS region,
       d.A4 AS population,
       d.A16 AS number_of_crimes_in_1996,
       CASE WHEN d.A15 IS NOT NULL AND d.A15 != 0 THEN ROUND((d.A16 - d.A15) * 100.0 / d.A15, 2) ELSE NULL END AS percentage_increase,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE district_id = d.district_id) AS total_accounts_opened
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY A16 DESC LIMIT 1)

WITH qualifying_tx AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance AS negative_balance, t.amount AS withdrawal_amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND t.balance < 0
),
qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM qualifying_tx
),
account_cards AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(c.card_id) AS card_count
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM qualifying_accounts)
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),
gold_cards_total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(c.card_id) AS total_gold
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM qualifying_accounts)
      AND c.type = 'gold'
),
distinct_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM qualifying_accounts)
),
owner_ages AS (
    SELECT c.client_id,
           (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2000-01-01') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) 
            - CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age,
           c.gender
    FROM client c
    JOIN distinct_owners o ON c.client_id = o.client_id
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT AVG(negative_balance) FROM qualifying_tx) AS avg_negative_balance,
    (SELECT MAX(withdrawal_amount) FROM qualifying_tx) AS max_withdrawal_amount,
    (SELECT AVG(card_count) FROM account_cards) AS avg_number_of_cards_per_account,
    (SELECT total_gold FROM gold_cards_total) AS total_gold_cards,
    (SELECT AVG(age) FROM owner_ages) AS avg_owner_age,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owner_ages WHERE gender = 'M') AS male_owners,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owner_ages WHERE gender = 'F') AS female_owners

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE loan.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' 
AND loan.amount >= 250000 
AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' 
AND loan.status = 'approved'

WITH loan_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM account
    JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
    WHERE district_id = 1 AND loan.status IN ('C', 'D')
),
owner_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan_accounts)
      AND type = 'OWNER'
),
client_details AS (
    SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM owner_clients)
),
card_holders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT disp.client_id
    FROM disp
    JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    WHERE disp.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM owner_clients)
),
trans_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS tx_count
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan_accounts)
    GROUP BY account_id
),
balances AS (
    SELECT la.account_id,
           (SELECT balance FROM trans
            WHERE account_id = la.account_id
            ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_balance
    FROM loan_accounts la
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AVG(CAST(amount AS REAL) - (payments * duration))
     FROM loan
     WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan_accounts)
       AND status IN ('C', 'D')
    ) AS avg_remaining_debt,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS male_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS female_count,
    AVG((julianday('now') - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25) AS avg_age,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card_holders) AS clients_with_card,
    COUNT(*) AS total_clients,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(tx_count) FROM trans_counts), 0) AS total_transactions,
    (SELECT AVG(tx_count) FROM trans_counts) AS avg_trans_per_account,
    (SELECT AVG(latest_balance) FROM balances) AS avg_balance
FROM client_details;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT district_id, A15
    FROM (
        SELECT district_id, A15, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY A15 DESC) AS rnk
        FROM district
    )
    WHERE rnk = 2
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client WHERE district_id = t.district_id AND gender = 'M') AS total_male_clients,
    t.A15 AS crime_count_1995,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) FROM disp d JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.district_id = t.district_id AND c.gender = 'M') AS total_accounts,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) FROM loan l JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.district_id = t.district_id AND c.gender = 'M') AS total_loans,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) FROM card cd JOIN disp d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.district_id = t.district_id AND c.gender = 'M') AS total_credit_cards,
    (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 0) FROM disp d JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.district_id = t.district_id AND c.gender = 'M') AS avg_dispositions_per_client,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FROM client c WHERE c.district_id = t.district_id AND c.gender = 'M' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disp d JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id WHERE d.client_id = c.client_id)) AS clients_with_loans,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c WHERE c.district_id = t.district_id AND c.gender = 'M' AND ((strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))) < 30) AS young_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c WHERE c.district_id = t.district_id AND c.gender = 'M' AND ((strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))) BETWEEN 30 AND 50) AS middle_aged_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c WHERE c.district_id = t.district_id AND c.gender = 'M' AND ((strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))) > 50) AS senior_count
FROM target t;

SELECT cl.gender,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS num_clients,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts,
       AVG(a.avg_balance) AS avg_balance,
       AVG((strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', cl.birth_date))) AS avg_age,
       AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS num_loans
FROM (
    SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
        FROM card c
        JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
        WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    )
    GROUP BY t.account_id
    HAVING AVG(t.balance) > 1000
) a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
GROUP BY cl.gender;

WITH pisek_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pisek_accounts) AS total_accounts,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)) AS total_transactions,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)) AS total_deposits,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)) AS total_withdrawals,
        (SELECT COALESCE(AVG(COALESCE(max_bal, 0)), 0) FROM (
            SELECT a.account_id, MAX(t.balance) AS max_bal
            FROM account a
            LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
            WHERE a.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)
            GROUP BY a.account_id
        )) AS avg_max_balance,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card c INNER JOIN disp dsp ON c.disp_id = dsp.disp_id WHERE dsp.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts) AND c.type = 'credit') AS total_credit_cards,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)) AS total_loans,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts) AND status = 'A') AS active_loan_amount,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM loan WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)) AS total_loan_amount,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) FROM disp WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts) AND type = 'OWNER') AS unique_owners
)
SELECT
    total_accounts,
    CASE WHEN total_accounts > 0 THEN total_transactions * 1.0 / total_accounts ELSE 0.0 END AS avg_transactions_per_account,
    total_deposits,
    total_withdrawals,
    avg_max_balance,
    total_credit_cards,
    total_loans,
    CASE WHEN total_loan_amount > 0 THEN active_loan_amount * 100.0 / total_loan_amount ELSE 0.0 END AS active_loan_percentage,
    unique_owners AS unique_account_owners
FROM stats;

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.date >= '1997-01-01' AND t.date <= '1997-12-31' AND t.amount > 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id
FROM `order` AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id
WHERE T1.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND T3.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card c JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE d.account_id = a.account_id AND c.type = 'gold') AS number_of_gold_cards,
    dt.A2 AS district_name,
    dt.A3 AS region,
    COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS net_income,
    ts.avg_balance,
    ts.min_balance,
    ts.max_balance,
    COALESCE(ls.total_loans, 0) AS total_loans,
    COALESCE(ls.good_loans, 0) AS good_loans,
    COALESCE(ls.bad_loans, 0) AS bad_loans,
    COALESCE(ls.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.avg_balance DESC) AS balance_rank
FROM account a
INNER JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
           AVG(balance) AS avg_balance,
           MIN(balance) AS min_balance,
           MAX(balance) AS max_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
) ts ON a.account_id = ts.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans,
           SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
) ls ON a.account_id = ls.account_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM disp d JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE d.account_id = a.account_id AND c.type = 'gold'
)
ORDER BY balance_rank

SELECT d.A3 AS region,
       d.A2 AS district,
       c.gender,
       ca.type AS card_type,
       AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_spending,
       d.A12 AS district_avg_salary,
       SUM(t.amount) / d.A12 AS spending_salary_ratio
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN card ca ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
GROUP BY d.A3, d.A2, c.gender, ca.type;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (
    SELECT AVG(amount)
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1998'
  )

WITH eligible_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', birth_date)) -
          (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date)) >= 18
),
owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id, d.disp_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN eligible_clients ec ON d.client_id = ec.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
has_card AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oa.client_id
    FROM owner_accounts oa
    JOIN card ca ON oa.disp_id = ca.disp_id
),
has_loan AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oa.client_id
    FROM owner_accounts oa
    JOIN loan l ON oa.account_id = l.account_id
),
client_loans AS (
    SELECT oa.client_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM owner_accounts oa
    JOIN loan l ON oa.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY oa.client_id
),
client_cards AS (
    SELECT oa.client_id,
           GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ca.type) AS card_types,
           MIN(ca.issued) AS earliest_card_issued
    FROM owner_accounts oa
    JOIN card ca ON oa.disp_id = ca.disp_id
    GROUP BY oa.client_id
),
client_loan_statuses AS (
    SELECT oa.client_id,
           GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
               CASE l.status
                   WHEN 'A' THEN 'Good Standing'
                   WHEN 'B' THEN 'Default'
                   ELSE l.status
               END
           ) AS loan_statuses
    FROM owner_accounts oa
    JOIN loan l ON oa.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY oa.client_id
),
client_transactions AS (
    SELECT oa.client_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM owner_accounts oa
    JOIN trans t ON oa.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY oa.client_id
),
client_profile AS (
    SELECT
        ec.client_id,
        ec.district_id,
        cl.total_loan_amount,
        cc.card_types,
        cc.earliest_card_issued,
        cls.loan_statuses,
        ct.total_income,
        ct.total_expense,
        CASE WHEN ct.total_income = 0 THEN NULL
             ELSE (ct.total_income - ct.total_expense) * 100.0 / ct.total_income
        END AS savings_rate
    FROM eligible_clients ec
    JOIN has_card hc ON ec.client_id = hc.client_id
    JOIN has_loan hl ON ec.client_id = hl.client_id
    LEFT JOIN client_loans cl ON ec.client_id = cl.client_id
    LEFT JOIN client_cards cc ON ec.client_id = cc.client_id
    LEFT JOIN client_loan_statuses cls ON ec.client_id = cls.client_id
    LEFT JOIN client_transactions ct ON ec.client_id = ct.client_id
)
SELECT
    client_id,
    district_id,
    total_loan_amount,
    card_types,
    earliest_card_issued,
    loan_statuses,
    total_income,
    total_expense,
    savings_rate,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY district_id ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC) AS regional_loan_ranking
FROM client_profile
ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.district_id,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       age.age_group,
       AVG(age.txn_count) AS avg_transaction_count,
       AVG(age.net_balance) AS avg_net_balance,
       AVG(age.total_loan_amount) AS avg_total_loan_amount,
       AVG(age.has_active_loan) AS active_loan_rate
FROM (
    SELECT oa.district_id,
           oa.birth_date,
           CASE
               WHEN oa.birth_date > '1980-12-31' THEN 'Young'
               WHEN oa.birth_date >= '1960-01-01' AND oa.birth_date <= '1980-12-31' THEN 'Middle-aged'
               ELSE 'Senior'
           END AS age_group,
           COUNT(t.trans_id) AS txn_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
               - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS net_balance,
           COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_active_loan
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id AND c.gender = 'F'
    JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id AND dis.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, c.district_id, c.birth_date
) AS age
JOIN district d ON age.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, age.age_group
ORDER BY d.district_id, age.age_group

SELECT
    cd.client_id,
    cd.gender,
    cd.age,
    cd.client_district,
    COALESCE(t.total_transactions, 0) AS total_transactions,
    COALESCE(t.total_transaction_amount, 0) AS total_transaction_amount,
    COALESCE(t.avg_transaction_amount, 0) AS avg_transaction_amount,
    COALESCE(t.avg_balance, 0) AS avg_balance,
    COALESCE(l.total_loans, 0) AS total_loans,
    COALESCE(l.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
    COALESCE(l.avg_loan_payment, 0) AS avg_loan_payment,
    CASE
        WHEN l.bad_loans > 0 THEN 'Bad'
        WHEN l.good_loans > 0 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'No Loans'
    END AS credit_status,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY cd.age DESC),
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.avg_balance, 0) DESC)
    ) AS priority_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        c.gender,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) -
            (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age,
        d2.A2 AS client_district
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id
    WHERE c.client_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
        FROM disp d
        JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
        WHERE dist.A2 = 'Tabor' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    )
) cd
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        d.client_id,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount,
        AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM disp d
    JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND d.client_id IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT d2.client_id
          FROM disp d2
          JOIN account a2 ON d2.account_id = a2.account_id
          JOIN district dist ON a2.district_id = dist.district_id
          WHERE dist.A2 = 'Tabor' AND d2.type = 'OWNER'
      )
    GROUP BY d.client_id
) t ON cd.client_id = t.client_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        d.client_id,
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
        AVG(l.payments) AS avg_loan_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans
    FROM disp d
    JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND d.client_id IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT d3.client_id
          FROM disp d3
          JOIN account a3 ON d3.account_id = a3.account_id
          JOIN district dist ON a3.district_id = dist.district_id
          WHERE dist.A2 = 'Tabor' AND d3.type = 'OWNER'
      )
    GROUP BY d.client_id
) l ON cd.client_id = l.client_id
ORDER BY priority_rank

SELECT DISTINCT d.type, dist.A11
FROM disp d
INNER JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE d.type != 'OWNER'
  AND dist.A11 > 8000
  AND dist.A11 <= 9000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
INNER JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
INNER JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND trans.bank = 'AB'

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_withdrawals_count,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal_amount,
       CAST(d.A4 AS REAL) AS population,
       d.A11 AS average_salary,
       d.A13 AS unemployment_rate_95,
       d.A10 AS urban_inhabitants_ratio,
       SUM(t.amount) / CAST(d.A4 AS REAL) AS withdrawal_per_capita,
       CASE
           WHEN d.A13 > 2.0 THEN 'High'
           WHEN d.A13 >= 1.0 THEN 'Medium'
           ELSE 'Low'
       END AS unemployment_category,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC) AS rank
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A4, d.A11, d.A13, d.A10
SELECT AVG(A15) FROM district WHERE A15 > 4000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account WHERE account.district_id = district.district_id AND date >= '1997-01-01')

SELECT dist.district_id,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oc.client_id)
        FROM disp d
        JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
        JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
        WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
          AND c.type = 'classic'
          AND cl.district_id = dist.district_id) AS num_classic_holders,
       (SELECT AVG(l.amount)
        FROM disp d
        JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
        JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
        JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
        WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
          AND c.type = 'classic'
          AND cl.district_id = dist.district_id) AS avg_loan_amount,
       (SELECT AVG(bal.balance)
        FROM disp d
        JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
        JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
        JOIN (SELECT account_id,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) -
                     SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS balance
              FROM trans
              GROUP BY account_id) bal ON d.account_id = bal.account_id
        WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
          AND c.type = 'classic'
          AND cl.district_id = dist.district_id) AS avg_account_balance,
       (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
                    THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*)
                    ELSE NULL END
        FROM disp d
        JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
        JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
        JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
        WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
          AND c.type = 'classic'
          AND cl.district_id = dist.district_id) AS loan_performance,
       dist.A11 AS district_salary,
       dist.A12 AS unemployment_rate
FROM district dist
ORDER BY dist.district_id;

WITH ref_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS today
    FROM (
        SELECT MAX(date) AS date FROM trans
        UNION
        SELECT MAX(date) FROM loan
        UNION
        SELECT MAX(date) FROM account
    )
),
prague_male AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date,
           CAST((julianday((SELECT today FROM ref_date)) - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.A3 = 'Prague'
),
client_age_group AS (
    SELECT client_id,
           CASE
               WHEN age < 30 THEN 'Young'
               WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
               ELSE 'Senior'
           END AS age_group
    FROM prague_male
),
owned_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND d.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM client_age_group)
),
last_balance_per_account AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance AS last_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.trans_id IN (SELECT MAX(trans_id) FROM trans GROUP BY account_id)
      AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM owned_accounts)
),
account_loans AS (
    SELECT l.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans,
           SUM(l.amount) AS sum_loan_amount
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM owned_accounts)
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
account_trans AS (
    SELECT account_id, type,
           COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
           SUM(amount) AS txn_sum_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM owned_accounts)
      AND type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
    GROUP BY account_id, type
),
account_income AS (
    SELECT account_id, txn_count AS num_income_txn, txn_sum_amount AS sum_income_amount
    FROM account_trans WHERE type = 'PRIJEM'
),
account_expense AS (
    SELECT account_id, txn_count AS num_expense_txn, txn_sum_amount AS sum_expense_amount
    FROM account_trans WHERE type = 'VYDAJ'
),
cards_per_client AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, COUNT(c.card_id) AS num_cards
    FROM owned_accounts d
    LEFT JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    GROUP BY d.client_id
),
client_financials AS (
    SELECT ag.client_id, ag.age_group,
           COALESCE(SUM(lb.last_balance), 0) AS total_balance,
           COUNT(oa.account_id) AS num_accounts,
           COALESCE(SUM(al.num_loans), 0) AS num_loans,
           COALESCE(SUM(al.good_loans), 0) AS good_loans,
           COALESCE(SUM(al.bad_loans), 0) AS bad_loans,
           COALESCE(SUM(al.sum_loan_amount), 0) AS sum_loan_amount,
           COALESCE(SUM(ai.num_income_txn), 0) AS num_income_txn,
           COALESCE(SUM(ai.sum_income_amount), 0) AS sum_income_amount,
           COALESCE(SUM(ae.num_expense_txn), 0) AS num_expense_txn,
           COALESCE(SUM(ae.sum_expense_amount), 0) AS sum_expense_amount,
           COALESCE(MAX(cpc.num_cards), 0) AS num_cards
    FROM client_age_group ag
    LEFT JOIN owned_accounts oa ON ag.client_id = oa.client_id
    LEFT JOIN last_balance_per_account lb ON oa.account_id = lb.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_loans al ON oa.account_id = al.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_income ai ON oa.account_id = ai.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_expense ae ON oa.account_id = ae.account_id
    LEFT JOIN cards_per_client cpc ON ag.client_id = cpc.client_id
    GROUP BY ag.client_id, ag.age_group
)
SELECT age_group,

       CASE WHEN SUM(num_loans) > 0 THEN SUM(sum_loan_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(num_loans) ELSE NULL END AS avg_loan_amount,
       AVG(num_income_txn) AS avg_income_txn_count,
       CASE WHEN SUM(num_income_txn) > 0 THEN SUM(sum_income_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(num_income_txn) ELSE NULL END AS avg_income_amount,
       AVG(num_expense_txn) AS avg_expense_txn_count,
       CASE WHEN SUM(num_expense_txn) > 0 THEN SUM(sum_expense_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(num_expense_txn) ELSE NULL END AS avg_expense_amount,

SELECT

    cl.gender,
    cl.birth_date,
    CASE
        WHEN (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) -
             (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', cl.birth_date)) < 30 THEN 'Young'
        WHEN (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) -
             (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', cl.birth_date)) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
        ELSE 'Senior'
    END AS age_category,
    COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    CASE
        WHEN ta.total_income = 0 OR ta.total_income IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((ta.total_income - ta.total_expense) * 100.0 / ta.total_income, 2)
    END AS savings_rate,
    ml.amount AS largest_loan_amount,
    d.A13 AS unemployment_rate,
    CASE WHEN d.A13 > 1.0 THEN 'High unemployment' ELSE 'Low unemployment' END AS economic_status
FROM max_loan ml
JOIN account ac ON ml.account_id = ac.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON ac.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id
JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id

WITH accounts_in_district AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik'
),
transaction_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_transactions,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_transactions,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_incoming_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_outgoing_amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_in_district)
),
loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_loans,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
        AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_in_district)
),
latest_balance AS (
    SELECT account_id, balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS rn
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_in_district)
),
avg_balance AS (
    SELECT AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM latest_balance WHERE rn = 1
),
gender_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cl.gender = 'M' THEN cl.client_id END) AS male_clients,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cl.gender = 'F' THEN cl.client_id END) AS female_clients
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
    WHERE d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_in_district)
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_in_district) AS total_accounts,
    t.total_transactions,
    t.incoming_transactions,
    t.outgoing_transactions,
    t.total_incoming_amount,
    t.total_outgoing_amount,
    l.total_loans,
    l.good_loans,
    l.bad_loans,
    l.total_loan_amount,
    l.avg_loan_amount,
    b.avg_balance,
    g.male_clients,
    g.female_clients
FROM transaction_stats t
CROSS JOIN loan_stats l
CROSS JOIN avg_balance b
CROSS JOIN gender_stats g

SELECT level_type, region, district_id, district_name, num_accounts, avg_district_salary, loan_adoption_rate, avg_loan_amount, avg_transactions_per_account, avg_account_balance
FROM (
    WITH target_accounts AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id
        FROM account a
        JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
        WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    ),
    district_info AS (
        SELECT ta.account_id, ta.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region, d.A11 AS district_avg_salary
        FROM target_accounts ta
        JOIN district d ON ta.district_id = d.district_id
    ),
    loan_info AS (
        SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_loans, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
        FROM loan l
        WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM target_accounts)
        GROUP BY l.account_id
    ),
    trans_count AS (
        SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) AS trans_cnt
        FROM trans t
        WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM target_accounts)
        GROUP BY t.account_id
    ),
    latest_balance AS (
        SELECT account_id, balance
        FROM (
            SELECT account_id, balance,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC) AS rn
            FROM trans
            WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM target_accounts)
        ) sub
        WHERE rn = 1
    ),
    account_level AS (
        SELECT di.region, di.district_id, di.district_name, di.district_avg_salary, di.account_id,
               COALESCE(li.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
               COALESCE(li.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
               COALESCE(tc.trans_cnt, 0) AS trans_cnt,
               lb.balance AS latest_balance
        FROM district_info di
        LEFT JOIN loan_info li ON di.account_id = li.account_id
        LEFT JOIN trans_count tc ON di.account_id = tc.account_id
        LEFT JOIN latest_balance lb ON di.account_id = lb.account_id
    )
    SELECT 'Region' AS level_type,
           region,
           NULL AS district_id,
           NULL AS district_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS num_accounts,
           AVG(district_avg_salary) AS avg_district_salary,
           CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN num_loans > 0 THEN account_id END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS loan_adoption_rate,
           CASE WHEN SUM(num_loans) > 0 THEN SUM(total_loan_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(num_loans) ELSE NULL END AS avg_loan_amount,
           AVG(trans_cnt * 1.0) AS avg_transactions_per_account,
           AVG(latest_balance) AS avg_account_balance
    FROM account_level
    GROUP BY region
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'District' AS level_type,
           region,
           district_id,
           district_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS num_accounts,
           AVG(district_avg_salary) AS avg_district_salary,
           CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN num_loans > 0 THEN account_id END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS loan_adoption_rate,
           CASE WHEN SUM(num_loans) > 0 THEN SUM(total_loan_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(num_loans) ELSE NULL END AS avg_loan_amount,
           AVG(trans_cnt * 1.0) AS avg_transactions_per_account,
           AVG(latest_balance) AS avg_account_balance
    FROM account_level
    GROUP BY district_id
)
ORDER BY level_type, region, district_id
