SELECT
  (tfl.payments * tfl.duration) AS Total_Payments,
  (tfl.payments * tfl.duration - tfl.amount) AS Interest_Paid,
  tfl.status AS Loan_Status,
  d.A2 AS Location,
  COALESCE(ta.transaction_count, 0) AS Transaction_Activity,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) > 2 * tfl.amount THEN 'High'
    WHEN COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) > tfl.amount THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS Income_Category,
  (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', tfl.birth_date) AS INTEGER) -
   (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', tfl.birth_date))) AS Age
FROM (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS overall_rn
  FROM (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, c.district_id AS client_district_id,
           l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.client_id ORDER BY l.amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) tfl
JOIN district d ON tfl.client_district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
) ta ON tfl.account_id = ta.account_id
WHERE tfl.overall_rn <= 3
ORDER BY tfl.amount DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) FROM client cl INNER JOIN disp d ON cl.client_id = d.client_id INNER JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id WHERE cl.gender = 'M' AND cl.birth_date BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31' AND t.operation = 'SIPO' AND t.amount > 4000

WITH account_years AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
           a.date AS open_date
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE LOWER(d.A2) = 'beroun' AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
),
owner_demo AS (
    SELECT ay.year, ay.account_id,
           c.gender,
           c.birth_date
    FROM account_years ay
    LEFT JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = ay.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    LEFT JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
),
txn_agg AS (
    SELECT ay.year, ay.account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expenses
    FROM account_years ay
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = ay.account_id
    GROUP BY ay.year, ay.account_id
),
loan_agg AS (
    SELECT ay.year, ay.account_id,
           COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_loans
    FROM account_years ay
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = ay.account_id
    GROUP BY ay.year, ay.account_id
),
card_agg AS (
    SELECT ay.year, ay.account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'classic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS classic_cards,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'junior' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS junior_cards,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards
    FROM account_years ay
    LEFT JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = ay.account_id
    LEFT JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    GROUP BY ay.year, ay.account_id
)
SELECT 
    ay.year,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN od.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS male_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN od.gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS female_count,
    AVG( (julianday(ay.open_date) - julianday(od.birth_date)) / 365.25 ) AS avg_age,
    COALESCE(SUM(ta.total_income), 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(SUM(ta.total_expenses), 0) AS total_expenses,
    COALESCE(SUM(la.total_loans), 0) AS total_loans,
    COALESCE(SUM(la.successful_loans), 0) AS successful_loans,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(la.total_loans), 0) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(la.successful_loans) AS REAL) / SUM(la.total_loans) ELSE 0.0 END AS success_rate,
    COALESCE(SUM(ca.classic_cards), 0) AS classic_cards,
    COALESCE(SUM(ca.junior_cards), 0) AS junior_cards,
    COALESCE(SUM(ca.gold_cards), 0) AS gold_cards
FROM account_years ay
LEFT JOIN owner_demo od ON od.year = ay.year AND od.account_id = ay.account_id
LEFT JOIN txn_agg ta ON ta.year = ay.year AND ta.account_id = ay.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_agg la ON la.year = ay.year AND la.account_id = ay.account_id
LEFT JOIN card_agg ca ON ca.year = ay.year AND ca.account_id = ay.account_id
GROUP BY ay.year
ORDER BY ay.year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client AS c
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
INNER JOIN card AS ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND ca.type = 'junior'

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district ds ON a.district_id = ds.district_id WHERE ds.A3 = 'Prague'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FROM client AS c INNER JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id INNER JOIN account AS a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

WITH
weekly_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN weekly_accounts w ON d.account_id = w.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id FROM owner_accounts
),
owner_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT o.client_id, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS txn_cnt
    FROM owners o
    LEFT JOIN owner_accounts oa ON o.client_id = oa.client_id
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON oa.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY o.client_id
),
credit_card_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.client_id
    FROM owners o
    JOIN disp d ON o.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
),
client_total_amount AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amt
    FROM disp d
    JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    GROUP BY d.client_id
),
high_volume_owners AS (
    SELECT o.client_id
    FROM owners o
    JOIN client_total_amount cta ON o.client_id = cta.client_id
    WHERE cta.total_amt > 10000
),
owner_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM owners o
    JOIN client c ON o.client_id = c.client_id
),
latest_balances AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC) as rn
    FROM trans t
    JOIN owner_accounts oa ON t.account_id = oa.account_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owners) AS num_owners,
    (SELECT AVG(txn_cnt) FROM owner_txn_counts) AS avg_txn,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM credit_card_owners) AS num_credit_card,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM high_volume_owners) AS num_high_volume,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owner_districts) AS num_districts,
    (SELECT AVG(balance) FROM latest_balances WHERE rn = 1) AS avg_balance

WITH eligible_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.duration > 24 AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
),
min_amount AS (
    SELECT MIN(amount) AS min_amt FROM eligible_loans
)
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS account_open_date,
    a.frequency,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments,
    l.status,
    l.date AS loan_date,
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.district_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    d.A4 AS inhabitants,
    d.A5 AS municipalities_lt_499,
    d.A6 AS municipalities_500_1999,
    d.A7 AS municipalities_2000_9999,
    d.A8 AS municipalities_gt_10000,
    d.A9 AS cities_gt_10000,
    d.A10 AS urban_ratio,
    d.A11 AS avg_salary,
    d.A12 AS unemployment_rate_95,
    d.A13 AS unemployment_rate_96,
    d.A14 AS entrepreneurs_per_1000,
    d.A15 AS crimes_95,
    d.A16 AS crimes_96,
    cr.card_id,
    cr.type AS card_type,
    cr.issued AS card_issued,
    t.trans_id,
    t.date AS trans_date,
    t.type AS trans_type,
    t.operation,
    t.amount AS trans_amount,
    t.balance,
    t.k_symbol AS trans_k_symbol,
    t.bank,
    t.account AS trans_partner_account,
    o.order_id,
    o.bank_to,
    o.account_to,
    o.amount AS order_amount,
    o.k_symbol AS order_k_symbol
FROM eligible_loans el
JOIN min_amount ma ON el.amount = ma.min_amt
JOIN account a ON el.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON el.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN card cr ON dp.disp_id = cr.disp_id
LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
ORDER BY a.account_id, t.date, o.order_id, cr.card_id;

SELECT dp.account_id
FROM disp dp
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
AND (c.birth_date, d.A11) = (
    SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date), MIN(d2.A11)
    FROM client c2
    JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
    WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
)

WITH fc AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 1920
),
account_summary AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts
    FROM fc
    LEFT JOIN disp dp ON fc.client_id = dp.client_id
    LEFT JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
),
loan_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
        COALESCE(AVG(l.amount), 0) AS avg_loan_amount,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.payments), 0) AS total_loan_payments
    FROM fc
    LEFT JOIN disp dp ON fc.client_id = dp.client_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON dp.account_id = l.account_id
),
trans_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_income,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_expense,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS income_transactions,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS expense_transactions
    FROM fc
    LEFT JOIN disp dp ON fc.client_id = dp.client_id
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON dp.account_id = t.account_id
),
most_common_district AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS district_name
    FROM fc
    JOIN district d ON fc.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY fc.district_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fc) AS total_clients,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fc WHERE gender = 'M') AS male_clients,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fc WHERE gender = 'F') AS female_clients,
    (SELECT total_accounts FROM account_summary) AS total_accounts,
    (SELECT total_loans FROM loan_summary) AS total_loans,
    (SELECT total_loan_amount FROM loan_summary) AS total_loan_amount,
    (SELECT avg_loan_amount FROM loan_summary) AS avg_loan_amount,
    (SELECT total_loan_payments FROM loan_summary) AS total_loan_payments,
    (SELECT total_transactions FROM trans_summary) AS total_transactions,
    (SELECT total_income FROM trans_summary) AS total_income,
    (SELECT total_expense FROM trans_summary) AS total_expense,
    (SELECT income_transactions FROM trans_summary) AS income_transactions,
    (SELECT expense_transactions FROM trans_summary) AS expense_transactions,
    (SELECT district_name FROM most_common_district) AS most_common_district;

WITH top_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.amount, l.payments, l.status, a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    INNER JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    INNER JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24 AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC
    LIMIT 50
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    AVG(tl.amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
    SUM(tl.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    AVG(tl.payments) AS avg_payments,
    SUM(tl.payments) AS total_payments,
    MIN(tl.payments) AS min_payments,
    MAX(tl.payments) AS max_payments,
    AVG(tl.payments * 24.0 / tl.amount - 1.0) AS avg_nominal_interest_rate,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tl.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_A,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tl.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_B,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tl.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_C,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tl.status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_D,
    AVG(d.A11) AS avg_district_salary,
    AVG(d.A12) AS avg_unemployment_rate_95,
    AVG(d.A13) AS avg_unemployment_rate_96,
    AVG(d.A14) AS avg_entrepreneurs_per_1000,
    AVG(d.A15) AS avg_crimes_95,
    AVG(d.A16) AS avg_crimes_96
FROM top_loans tl
LEFT JOIN district d ON tl.district_id = d.district_id
SELECT AVG(loan.amount) FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id WHERE loan.status IN ('C', 'D') AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, 
       (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE ca.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT B.bond_type,
       COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences,
       COUNT(DISTINCT B.molecule_id) AS molecule_count,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT B.molecule_id) AS avg_per_molecule,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A1.element <= A2.element THEN A1.element || '-' || A2.element ELSE A2.element || '-' || A1.element END)
        FROM connected C
        JOIN atom A1 ON C.atom_id = A1.atom_id
        JOIN atom A2 ON C.atom_id2 = A2.atom_id
        JOIN bond B2 ON C.bond_id = B2.bond_id
        WHERE B2.bond_type = B.bond_type) AS unique_element_pairs,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT M.label) AS molecule_labels
FROM bond B
JOIN molecule M ON B.molecule_id = M.molecule_id
WHERE B.bond_type = (
    SELECT bond_type
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY bond_type
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY B.bond_type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS molecule_count,
       AVG(num_cl) AS avg_chlorine_atoms,
       MAX(num_cl) AS max_chlorine_atoms,
       AVG(total_bonds) AS avg_bonds,
       SUM(CASE WHEN single_bonds > double_bonds THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS molecules_more_single,
       AVG(cl_bonds) AS avg_bonds_involving_chlorine
FROM (
  SELECT em.molecule_id,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = em.molecule_id AND element = 'cl') AS num_cl,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = em.molecule_id) AS total_bonds,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = em.molecule_id AND bond_type = '-') AS single_bonds,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = em.molecule_id AND bond_type = '=') AS double_bonds,
         (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
          FROM connected c
          JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
          JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
          WHERE a1.molecule_id = em.molecule_id
            AND a2.molecule_id = em.molecule_id
            AND (a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl')) AS cl_bonds
  FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
  ) em
)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-') 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-');

SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-') AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'na' AND T1.label = '-';

SELECT
  tm.molecule_id,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id) AS bond_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id AND element = 'C') AS carbon_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id AND element = 'N') AS nitrogen_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id AND bond_type = '#') AS total_triple_bonds,
  COALESCE(n_n.n_n_triple, 0) AS n_n_triple_bonds,
  COALESCE(c_trip.c_triple, 0) AS c_containing_triple_bonds
FROM (
  SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#'
) AS tm
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS n_n_triple
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id AND a1.element = 'N'
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id AND a2.element = 'N'
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
) n_n ON tm.molecule_id = n_n.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS c_triple
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND (a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C')
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
) c_trip ON tm.molecule_id = c_trip.molecule_id
ORDER BY total_triple_bonds;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom_id)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#';

WITH qualifying_molecules AS (
    SELECT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    )
    OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) > 1
),
atom_connections AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected c WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id) AS connection_count
    FROM atom a
    JOIN qualifying_molecules q ON a.molecule_id = q.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element != 'br'
)
SELECT AVG(connection_count) AS avg_connections,
       SUM(CASE WHEN connection_count > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS atoms_gt_2_connections
FROM atom_connections;

SELECT
  AVG(num_atoms) AS avg_num_atoms,
  AVG(num_carbons) AS avg_num_carbons,
  AVG(num_bonds) AS avg_num_bonds,
  AVG(num_double_bonds) AS avg_num_double_bonds,
  AVG(num_connected_atoms) AS avg_num_connected_atoms,
  AVG(ratio_CC) AS avg_ratio_CC
FROM (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS num_atoms,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'C') AS num_carbons,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS num_bonds,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = 'double') AS num_double_bonds,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.atom_id) FROM (
       SELECT c.atom_id FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
       UNION
       SELECT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
     ) ca) AS num_connected_atoms,
    (SELECT 
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 
            THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*)
            ELSE 0 
       END
     FROM bond b
     JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
     JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id AND a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
     JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id AND a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
     WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    ) AS ratio_CC
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
    AND m.label = '+'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element IN ('C','H'))
) AS stats

SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    COALESCE(ma.num_atoms, 0) AS num_atoms,
    COALESCE(mb.num_bonds, 0) AS num_bonds,
    COALESCE(ma.num_carbons, 0) AS num_carbons,
    COALESCE(ma.num_chlorines, 0) AS num_chlorines,
    COALESCE(mb.num_double_bonds, 0) AS num_double_bonds,
    COALESCE(mc.num_connections, 0) AS num_connections
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_carbons,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_chlorines
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
) ma ON m.molecule_id = ma.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_double_bonds
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY molecule_id
) mb ON m.molecule_id = mb.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        a1.molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_connections
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
    GROUP BY a1.molecule_id
) mc ON m.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id
WHERE ma.num_carbons > 0
ORDER BY ma.num_carbons DESC, ma.num_atoms DESC

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

WITH
double_bond_atoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, a.element, a.molecule_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2, a.element, a.molecule_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT
        element,
        COUNT(DISTINCT atom_id) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
    FROM double_bond_atoms
    GROUP BY element
),
total_atoms AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM atom
),
example_labels AS (
    SELECT
        element,
        GROUP_CONCAT(label, ', ') AS examples
    FROM (
        SELECT
            element,
            label,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY element ORDER BY label) AS rn
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT dba.element, m.label
            FROM double_bond_atoms dba
            JOIN molecule m ON dba.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        ) sub
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn <= 3
    GROUP BY element
)

    WHEN 'o' THEN 'Oxygen'
    WHEN 's' THEN 'Sulfur'
    WHEN 'n' THEN 'Nitrogen'
    WHEN 'p' THEN 'Phosphorus'
    WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
    WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
    WHEN 'f' THEN 'Fluorine'
    WHEN 'i' THEN 'Iodine'
    WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
    WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
    WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
    WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    ELSE a.element
  END AS element_name
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'

SELECT ROUND(
  (gap_seconds / (champ_seconds + gap_seconds)) * 100,
  2
) AS percent_faster
FROM (
  SELECT
    (CAST(SUBSTR(champ_time, 1, INSTR(champ_time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 +
     CAST(SUBSTR(champ_time, INSTR(champ_time, ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(champ_time, INSTR(champ_time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
     CAST(SUBSTR(champ_time, INSTR(champ_time, ':') + INSTR(SUBSTR(champ_time, INSTR(champ_time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS REAL)) AS champ_seconds,
    CASE 
      WHEN gap_str LIKE '%:%' THEN 
        (CAST(SUBSTR(gap_str, 1, INSTR(gap_str, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
         CAST(SUBSTR(gap_str, INSTR(gap_str, ':') + 1) AS REAL))
      ELSE 
        CAST(gap_str AS REAL)
    END AS gap_seconds
  FROM (
    SELECT
      (SELECT time FROM results r WHERE r.raceId = race.raceId AND position = 1) AS champ_time,
      CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT time FROM results r WHERE r.raceId = race.raceId ORDER BY position DESC LIMIT 1) LIKE '+%'
        THEN SUBSTR((SELECT time FROM results r WHERE r.raceId = race.raceId ORDER BY position DESC LIMIT 1), 2)
        ELSE (SELECT time FROM results r WHERE r.raceId = race.raceId ORDER BY position DESC LIMIT 1)
      END AS gap_str
    FROM (
      SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    ) AS race
  ) AS t1
) AS t2

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Inpatient_Male_Count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Outpatient_Male_Count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'More Inpatient'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'More Outpatient'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS Comparison,

WITH cust_seg AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment FROM customers WHERE Currency = 'CZK' AND Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
),
cust_total AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE substr(Date,1,4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
joined AS (
    SELECT cs.Segment, ct.CustomerID, ct.total_cons
    FROM cust_seg cs
    JOIN cust_total ct ON cs.CustomerID = ct.CustomerID
),
min_per_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY Segment
),
min_customers AS (
    SELECT j.Segment, j.CustomerID, j.total_cons
    FROM joined j
    JOIN min_per_seg m ON j.Segment = m.Segment AND j.total_cons = m.min_cons
),
avg_per_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_cons) / COUNT(*) AS avg_cons
    FROM min_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avg_per_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avg_per_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avg_per_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avg_per_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avg_per_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avg_per_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff

WITH seg_pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        ((SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
          SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0) /
          NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_increase
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase
FROM seg_pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM seg_pct)
   OR pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM seg_pct)
